commit.message:
Opencolorio/openimageio windows linkage fix (#175)

* Opencolorio/openimageio windows linkage fix

Windows only problem :

The FindOpenColorIO/FindOpenImageIO files were linking to the
release version even in debug, causing crashes.

I also discovered that the build script builds release versions
of the standalone tool executables as well as python plugins.

To band-aid this, I made it so that it also copies the release dlls
on windows.

At some point we need to go back and fix that, as well as fix our
python package and rev it so that it has debug python in its find
file.  But for now, this is at least an improvement that stops
the editor crashing and also makes the command line tools usable.

fixes https://github.com/o3de/o3de/issues/14065




Signed-off-by: lawsonamzn <70027408+lawsonamzn@users.noreply.github.com>

Opencolorio/openimageio windows linkage fix (#175)

* Opencolorio/openimageio windows linkage fix

Windows only problem :

The FindOpenColorIO/FindOpenImageIO files were linking to the
release version even in debug, causing crashes.

I also discovered that the build script builds release versions
of the standalone tool executables as well as python plugins.

To band-aid this, I made it so that it also copies the release dlls
on windows.

At some point we need to go back and fix that, as well as fix our
python package and rev it so that it has debug python in its find
file.  But for now, this is at least an improvement that stops
the editor crashing and also makes the command line tools usable.

fixes https://github.com/o3de/o3de/issues/14065




Signed-off-by: lawsonamzn <70027408+lawsonamzn@users.noreply.github.com>

+    # On windows, these DLL files have a corresponding .lib (import library) that must be linked.  On other platforms,
